content:
Update: All M6 Mac mini configurations are now back in stock on Amazon and available for pre-order.

AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 are still down $120, while the AirTag 2 is also on sale at an all-time low starting from $20 each, with limited stock so grab them while you can. Apple today officially launched the new generation Mac mini with the M6 chip, now available for pre-order, and you can get over $500 off when you trade in a mid-tier M4 Mac mini at Apple (more details here). While the Apple Polishing Cloth isn't technically a deal, the new generation is officially on sale with a significant price drop to $9, and the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB model is also $400 off. Twelve South TimePorter watch band organizer is now shipping for under $21 with Prime, details below.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: brand new 2026 AirTag 2 now from just $20 each

While some Apple deals started to rise in price last week, this week brings a brand new deal — the 2026 AirTag 2 has hit its all-time low price on Amazon, from just $20 each.

Amazon continues to offer the single AirTag 2 down to $24 with Prime shipping, the all-time lowest price and the best deal we've tracked for this model since its launch.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regular price $29) — matching the all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (regular price $99) — new all-time low

However, if you can make good use of four AirTags, or split the cost of the 4-pack with friends, the per-unit average drops to just $20.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regular price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regular price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular price $129)

New generation M6 Mac mini pre-order deals now live: $500+ off with M4 trade-in

Update: M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro Mac mini are now available for pre-order on Amazon:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple officially launched the all-new M6 Mac mini, now available for pre-order alongside the new generation M5 Pro models and the new Mac Studio. Trade in a mid-tier M4 model and pick up an M6 Mac mini for just $374.

M6 Mac mini pre-orders now live

***Note: We'll be closely monitoring pre-order deals across websites all morning today, and expect notable trade-in options — and possibly even gift card promotions dropping today — as the new machines land on Amazon, Best Buy, and other platforms.

As the previous generation Mac mini was nearly completely sold out at retail, Apple officially unveiled the all-new Mac mini. As the first Mac to feature the M6 chip, it retains the familiar form factor with a base configuration of 512GB RAM, and is now available for pre-order on Apple's official website:

  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB from $899
  • M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB from $1,699

M6 Mac mini trade-in deals

Apple is, of course, offering trade-in discounts on the new Mac mini. For example, trading in a mid-tier M4 Mac mini with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage gets you an instant $525 off, bringing the M6 Mac mini down to $374.

See below for all the details on the new Mac mini and Mac Studio:

Tim Cook adds a new generation Apple Polishing Cloth to his legendary chapter, priced at just $9

Stay tuned to 9to5Mac this morning, as Apple has just unveiled the new generation M6 and M5 Ultra chips, along with the Mac mini and Mac Studio models equipped with the new chips. While this news is exciting, Mr. Cook has apparently decided to bow out in a more attention-grabbing way — Apple officially launched the brand new generation Polishing Cloth, priced at just $9.

AirPods deals are about to end, grab the 2026 AirPods Max 2 with $120 off while you still can

We've been rounding up AirPods deals for you over the past week, but prices are quickly rising back up. If you want to grab the new generation AirPods Max 2 with $120 off, we recommend jumping on it soon.

Amazon continues to offer the Midnight Black AirPods Max 2 for $429 with Prime shipping as a summer deal. Other colors have already ticked back up slightly to $449, and the Midnight Black version is expected to follow suit soon.

The Midnight Black version, normally $549, is still $120 off; other colors have seen discounts shrink slightly to $100.

This deal mainly carries over from last week's big anniversary event, and prices are expected to rise across other colors in the short term.

This is the second-lowest price we've recorded for the new generation 2026 AirPods Max 2. Back during June Prime Day, there was a brief $150 discount — the only time the product has dipped below its current price.

48GB M5 Pro MacBook Pro down $400 today, but this config might be the better choice

Amazon continues to offer a significant deal on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, down $500; but we've also spotted B&H offering the 48GB M5 Pro version at the same price with a $400 discount.

Today's Amazon promotion features a model with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage, packing an upgraded 18-core/20-core processor, priced at $2,699 with fast shipping — $500 off the regular $3,199 price, making it one of the best M5 Pro deals we've tracked in months.

However, if you prioritize double the RAM, B&H is currently offering the same 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM, 1TB storage, and a 15-core/16-core configuration at the same $2,699 price with fast shipping.

That model is normally $3,099 and is now $400 off.

Half the RAM with double the storage and a stronger processor… or double the RAM with half the storage and the base processor. Each has its merits, but no matter which you choose, you're getting a hefty discount.

Personally, I lean toward RAM over storage, but 48GB does seem a bit extravagant, and the stronger Core configuration is also quite tempting. I'd personally go with Amazon's deal.

If you have your eye on the 16-inch model, Apple's official refurbished store also has noteworthy discounts:

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (regular $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (regular $3,599 new)

Catch the M6 Mac mini hype: Samsung 32-inch Smart Monitor back down to $180 low

Anker 7-in-1 Nano charging station with retractable USB-C and smart display down to $60 (25% off)

Following this morning's 10-in-1 clamp-on power strip deal, the Anker Amazon storefront has also discounted the 7-in-1 Nano charging station to $60 with fast shipping.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is once again offering the 7-in-1 Nano charging station for $59.98 with fast shipping.

Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch band organizer hits a yearly low at $21 with Prime shipping

Amazon is selling the Twelve South TimePorter watch band organizer at its lowest price of the year. This elegant, wall-mountable organizer neatly displays Apple Watch bands and is now available for under $21 with Prime shipping.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Satechi semi-transparent 4-in-1 USB-C portable dock with 4K HDMI down to $38
  • LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 display hits a new low, $2,200 cheaper than Studio Display XDR
  • Whisker launches $100 Labor Day discount, Litter-Robot bundles from $704
  • Slim UGREEN wallet tracker supports iPhone and Android, down to $20 all-time low today
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter drops to $40 on Amazon (black or white)

Anker's sleek clamp-on power strip helps tidy your desk, now $58

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired model also available)

Amazon's summer deals cover Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home products, while also delivering the lowest price ever for the new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro and repricing the wired model at its Prime Day all-time low — both at nearly 30% off.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regular $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regular $250)

Although the brand later launched the $100 Ring Peephole Cam 2K to cater to more budget-conscious users, today's spotlight is on the latest Pro series 4K models on sale.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro has returned to its Prime Day all-time low — the first time it's hit this price since the late June sales event. This is actually only the second time we've recorded this model below $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro sees its first discount, also hitting an all-time low of $180.

As shown above, both models are regularly $250 and are now nearly 30% off, making them the lowest prices and best deals we've seen to date.

Both share similar features, including up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K imaging to keep watch over your doorstep; the wireless model uses a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easier charging and installation (no wiring required), while the wired model delivers 'uninterrupted all-day protection.'

For more details, check out our September launch coverage from last year.

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My wallet card supports iOS or Android, down to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently launched the new SmartTrack Find My Card wallet tracker — its first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — now at an all-time low on Amazon at $25 with Prime shipping.

Anker's EufyHome Amazon official storefront is selling the brand new SmartTrack Card E40 (supporting iOS or Android) for $24.99 with fast shipping, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

The product first hit Amazon last month at $35, with a slight $5 discount at month's end, and now sees its first significant price cut, hitting an all-time low on Amazon.

That's nearly 30% off, comparable to some of the wallet tracker deals we've tracked this year.

I'm a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards — the basic version starts at $35, and the Pro version with 16-month battery life before needing a recharge is priced at $45 — but no matter which you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 packs all the important features, including wireless charging, while supporting both the Apple Find My platform and Google Find Hub. At just 1.7mm thin and with volume up to 80dB, it's easy to find the device when nearby — and of course, you can view its location on a map via the Find My and Find Hub apps.

Amazon Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro down $220 (matching Prime Day deals)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my first stop for discounted iPhones, Apple has yet to list the latest iPhone 17 Pro on that platform — stock is expected after next month's iPhone 18 lineup launch. Amazon Premium Renewed premium inventory has now returned to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off compared to new units.

Amazon Premium Renewed premium inventory has been the best way to get a discounted unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. You not only save hundreds of dollars, but also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'greater than 90% of original battery life' — Amazon's non-'Premium' refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and have weaker battery life standards.

Right now, 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock with up to $220 off, and the 512GB version is an additional $20 cheaper than when we last reported:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)

As covered in yesterday's Apple refurbished store feature, you can now pick up an iPhone 16 with 1 year of Apple warranty for as low as $699, or grab the 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $700 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)
